# Runtime Configuration

| Environment variable | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `HADOCS_HASK_ENABLED` | `false` | Enables explicit runtime manager startup |
| `HADOCS_HASK_BUNDLE_PATH` | empty | Optional local bundle directory |
| `HADOCS_HASK_STRICT_VALIDATION` | `true` | Enables reference validation |
| `HADOCS_HASK_CACHE_ENABLED` | `true` | Enables process-local immutable snapshot reuse |

When disabled, startup performs no discovery or bundle I/O. When enabled without a valid bundle, the manager reports internal degraded diagnostics and HADocs continues normally. No network discovery or download exists.
